title: Race these
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: You can race your own Nyborgs now. In the Customizer, pick two to four of them (the same one twice is fine), choose a seed and press Race these. The viewer plays their builds on the Ring and draws each one in its own yarn colour, strands, glasses and hat, with its name on the board.

The link is shareable: the engine only ever sees the seed and the builds, so anyone who opens it watches the same race. A build that doesn't pass the engine's check races the default build instead, with a short note saying why. Tank Watch links carry looks too.
next: Laps and track in the link, and saving a Nyborg from a shared link.
